description: Data Used for EDeMOS (Electricity Demand Mapping from Open-Source Data): Kenya Case Study is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Roberto Heredia-Fonseca, Ariane Millot (Imperial College London). The information in this repository pertains to the Kenya case study for EDeMOS. EDeMOS is an open-source methodology designed for analyzing electricity consumption at a spatially detailed level in any geography. References. A high-resolution gridded dataset to assess electrification in sub-Saharan Africa Falchetta, G., Pachauri, S., Parkinson, S. et al. Coverage: national (KE); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
